name: Camera-pipeline traces (CFA and resampling)
corpus: synthetic photo-like scenes generated from fixed seeds (forensic.validation.run.scene)

detection.task: Does the image carry colour-filter-array demosaicing traces at native resolution?
detection.positives: 80 scenes re-shot through an RGGB Bayer mosaic and demosaiced (bilinear), stored lossless
detection.negatives: the same 80 scenes never mosaiced (as a renderer or generator outputs them)

resampling.task: Was the image scaled after capture (periodic interpolation correlations)?
resampling.positives: 80 scenes scaled by 1.5 (bilinear), lossless; other factors in tpr_by_condition
resampling.negatives: the same 80 scenes unscaled; also each saved once as JPEG 90 (grid peaks excluded)

known_failure_modes: CFA traces do not survive JPEG at quality 95 or below, nor resizing (see tpr_by_condition): their absence says little about most delivered images.

Simulated with bilinear demosaicing; camera pipelines use adaptive demosaicing, denoising and sharpening that weaken the pattern, and a generator could imitate it. Measure on camera originals before relying on absence.
Resampling detection fails for down-scaling and after JPEG compression at common qualities.
